tail: The phone's screen always stays turned toward the person: the camera never sees it, only its acid lime light on the face and hands, breathing softly. Realistic, cinematic, 35mm, subtle film grain, natural human movement, palette of black, deep olive and acid lime neon #CCFF00 (a yellow-green, never pure yellow or orange). No on-screen text, no subtitles, no logos, no numbers. Audio: no voice, no speech, no narration, no music with lyrics.

clips.motion: From the very first frame there is movement: the tram sways gently and city lights slide past the window. She looks down at her phone, then slowly lifts her eyes straight into the camera and holds the gaze without blinking. Slow handheld push-in.
clips.sound: a low bass hit on the first frame, the rumble of the tram, a soft neon buzz.

clips.motion: From the very first frame there is movement: rain falls through the light, cars pass behind him in long streaks. He stands still in the crossing, looking at his phone, then raises his eyes into the camera and holds them there. Slow push-in.
clips.sound: rain on the asphalt, a car passing close, a deep sub pulse.

clips.motion: From the very first frame there is movement: the city lights behind the glass flicker on one by one. She looks at her phone, then turns her eyes from the phone to the camera and holds the gaze, calm, not blinking. Slow push-in toward her eyes.
clips.sound: the distant hum of the city, one soft click.

clips.motion: From the very first frame there is movement: steam rises from the kettle. He scrolls with his thumb, eyes sharp and awake, then glances up into the camera for a moment. Slight handheld drift.
clips.sound: a kettle starting to hiss, a low electric hum.

clips.motion: From the very first frame there is movement: a train rushes past behind her, its windows strobing light across her. She keeps watching her phone and does not flinch; as the train is gone she looks up into the camera. Static camera.
clips.sound: the whoosh of a passing train, then sudden silence.

clips.motion: From the very first frame there is movement: city lights slide over the car window and across his face. He looks at his phone with a half smile, then lifts his eyes into the camera and holds them. Gentle car motion.
clips.sound: a car engine at night, the tick of an indicator.

clips.motion: From the very first frame there is movement: he taps his phone once with his thumb, the light on his face brightens, a small smile, then he looks up into the camera. Slow push-in.
clips.sound: a soft tap, then a warm electronic chime.

clips.motion: From the very first frame there is movement: she walks toward the camera, glances at her phone one last time, slips it into her coat pocket and walks on; the lime light fades from her face and the street lights take over. Tracking shot backwards.
clips.sound: footsteps on wet pavement, a soft fading hum.

clips.motion: From the very first frame there is movement: a washing machine drum turns behind her. She looks at her phone, then looks up into the camera. Slow push-in.
clips.sound: the hum and rhythm of washing machines.

clips.motion: From the very first frame there is movement: street lights pass over the bus window and over his face. He looks at his phone, then looks up into the camera. The bus sways.
clips.sound: a bus engine, the rattle of a window.

clips.motion: From the very first frame there is movement: wind moves his hair and jacket. He looks at his phone, then looks up into the camera. Slow push-in.
clips.sound: wind on a rooftop, the city far below.

clips.motion: From the very first frame there is movement: rain drops run down the windscreen, blurred lights shimmer. She looks at her phone, then looks up into the camera. Static camera.
clips.sound: rain on the roof of a car.

clips.motion: From the very first frame there is movement: her breath shows in the cold morning air, a few leaves move. She looks at her phone, calm and patient. Slow push-in.
clips.sound: birds, far traffic, a quiet breath.

clips.motion: From the very first frame there is movement: the city lights come on outside the window. She looks at her phone, the lime glow on her face growing a little stronger, a slight nod. Slow push-in.
clips.sound: office room tone, a low slow pulse.

clips.motion: From the very first frame there is movement: the intense lime light breathes on her face. She lifts her eyes from the phone straight into the camera and holds the gaze, never blinking. Slow push-in toward her eyes.
clips.sound: a deep bass hit on the first frame, then the steady buzz of neon.

clips.motion: From the very first frame there is movement: the pupil contracts sharply as the lime reflection on the eye flickers brighter, the eye stays wide open and never blinks, not once; a very slow push-in toward the pupil.
clips.sound: a hard electric zap and a deep bass hit on the very first frame, then a close, low neon buzz.

clips.motion: From the very first frame there is movement: the camera slowly pulls back and rises, revealing more and more windows, and in window after window another lime glow switches on, people looking down at their phones; nobody looks away.
clips.sound: a wide night city ambience, distant traffic, a low rising hum that swells as the windows light up.
